rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for describing someone as overweight, though it can sound blunt.

example.english: Stop eating so much—you’re really overweight.
example.traditional: 你唔好再食咁多啦，你真係肥喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 sik6 gam3 do1 laa1 nei5 zan1 hai6 fei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a health, diet, or weight assessment when you want to avoid directly calling someone fat.

example.english: The doctor says I’m slightly overweight, so I need to start exercising.
example.traditional: 醫生話我有少少過重，要開始做運動。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 siu2 siu2 gwo3 zung6 jiu3 hoi1 ci2 zou6 wan6 dung6
